strategy: Start by confirming gateway health and router load state without printing credentials.
Separate sendMessage and sendVoice delivery paths before changing shared proxy code.
Verify that both delivery paths inherit the same proxy configuration.
Treat consumed retry without terminal delivery event as a router failure, not as success.
Run only redacted fixture-mode smoke checks unless the user explicitly authorizes a real message.
Record evidence as delivery states and error categories, never as credentials or recipient identifiers.
summary: Hermes Telegram message router recovery discipline for proxy mismatch, sendMessage timeout, sendVoice delivery uncertainty, and missing terminal delivery state.
